description: Retrieve real-time DevTools logs (Console with numeric msgid & args, Network requests, Performance metrics). Supports msgid lookup, includePreserved/navigationId filtering, errorsOnly, and excludeStatic.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

detail.description: Output detail: summary minimizes tokens, standard preserves normal fields, full returns complete metrics (default: full)

errorsOnly.description: Only return console errors/assertions and failed/4xx/5xx network requests (default: false)

excludeStatic.description: Exclude static assets (images, fonts, media, stylesheets) from network requests (default: false)

filterOrigin.description: Filter out internal extension logs/warnings (chrome-extension://*). Default: true

includeHeaders.description: Include full HTTP response headers on network requests (default: false to save tokens)

includePreserved.description: Include console/network entries preserved across earlier navigations (default: true; set false for current navigation only)

msgid.description: Optional numeric console message ID (msgid) to inspect a single console message in full detail

navigationId.description: Optional navigationId to filter console/network entries to a specific navigation
